synthesis.guidance: Upstream states Shoelace is sunset with no active development. Use this only as historical design/API guidance or to maintain an existing Shoelace application; do not select it as a new dependency based on this archive. In the inspected React example, onSlAfterHide resets open state so user dismissal remains synchronized, the footer slot carries the close button, and --width sets dialog size. Replace the generic label and filler with a concrete heading and content. The 50vw example is not a mobile-safe guarantee: choose a content-based maximum and narrow-screen width with safe margins, then test long content, focus return and keyboard dismissal. Preserve existing typography instead of importing a whole new theme. React adapters/custom elements remain uninstalled; no script tags or rendered media are included.
synthesis.modifications: Original adaptation guidance and archive wrapper; copied excerpts retain recorded ranges and licensing.
synthesis.summary: A historical Shoelace React dialog synchronizes open state via onSlAfterHide, places its close action in the footer slot and exposes a --width property. Useful for maintaining existing component-based sites.
